title: 第6章 京城天牢，邪王来袭
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
四皇子，姜誉。
姜长生知道他，从陈礼嘴里得知的，姜誉是他的亲生弟弟，同父同母，也是皇后所生，据说就是生了姜誉，皇后娘娘才不再疯疯癫癫。
听闻是皇帝指点姜誉来的，姜长生浮想联翩。
莫非皇帝已经认出他来，为何没有直接与他相认？
姜长生不好直接询问此事，而是问道：“你想找我习武？”
姜誉兴奋道：“没错，父皇说你就比我大两岁，却已经超越一流之境，你可得当我的师父，你想要什么，我都满足你，金银财宝，奇珍异宝，你尽管说。”
姜长生想了想，有皇子的关系在，以后至少不会那么被动，他根本不用隐藏，毕竟他的敌人都知道他在这里。
“既然是陛下的指令，我自然不能拒绝，能教殿下武功，也是我的荣幸，不过我先说好，我教的武功都是我自创的，并非龙起观的武学。”
姜长生认真说道，姜誉大喜，当即就要跪下磕头，两位侍卫大惊失色，好在姜长生及时搀扶住姜誉。
这小子真是冒失……
让皇子磕头，那可是杀头大罪！
姜长生无奈道：“我并非你师父，只是教你武功罢了，以后可直呼我名。”
姜誉挺直腰杆，咧嘴笑道：“好的，长生哥！”
他迫不及待的催促道：“长生哥，快教我吧，我的目标是习得一身盖世武学，为我大景开疆扩土，荡平蛮荒，我前几日刚满十二岁，以前父皇不允许我在十二岁之前习武，你可是第一位教导我武功的人。”
姜长生想了想，决定将神影腿传授给姜誉。
神影腿是他学习的第一个武学，威力刚猛，一腿可摧筋断骨，他已经做到真气外放、踢出异象的强大境界。
姜长生开始传授神影腿的修行之法，两位侍卫避嫌，退到房门外，将房门掩上。
姜誉听得很认真。
一个时辰后，姜誉欢天喜地的离去，他得回皇宫练功，皇子不能在外过宿。
青苦回屋，兴奋的问道：“师兄，你现在是皇子师父了？”

姜长生摇头失笑道：“只是教殿下武功罢了，岂能当师父，莫要胡说。”
青苦不以为然：“那也很强啊，以后皇子就是你的靠山，我之前行走江湖，发现这天下是人情的天下，同一件事，不同的身份与关系去做，结果完全不同。”
他似乎想到了什么伤心事，笑容跟着消失。
姜长生一直好奇他到底经历了什么，但他从不肯说。
屋内陷入安静。
过了好一会儿，青苦告辞，屋内就剩下姜长生一人，他也终于可以安心练功。
第一次刺杀失败后，仇敌必然还会有第二次袭击，姜长生要尽可能的变强。
姜长生以道法自然功第三层的修为便足已傲绝龙起观，暂时他还没有遇到真气比他多的人，但不怕一万，就怕万一，他不能松懈。
修仙者岂能被一群凡间武夫弄死？
黄昏降临，阴云笼罩繁华的京城，绵绵细雨落下。
街道两边的商贩纷纷开始收摊，连绵起伏的朱楼披上一层水雾，整座城都变得朦脓。
京城西边城区，天牢大门前。
一身甲胄的张天忍皱眉望着天穹，眉宇间满是忧虑之色。
旁边一名中年将领拍了拍他的肩，笑道：“年轻人，不要总是心事重重的，头儿已经将你的名册上报，来年你便可以参加武科举。”
张天忍今年刚满十八岁，其母在入囚时已经怀上他，生下他后便被砍头，他是被天牢的狱卒带大，老一辈的狱卒都拿他当亲生儿子，传他各种武艺，他也确实争气，屡次建功。
张天忍收回目光，摇头道：“我总觉得天牢要出事。”
“胡说八道，天子脚下，难道还有人敢劫狱不成？”
中年将领笑骂道，附近其他守卫皆是大笑。
在京城，天牢是最安全的地方，他们的职责也很简单，他们很享受现在的生活，不累，但俸禄高。
张天忍无奈一笑，他也觉得自己可能想多了。

自大景立国起，京城虽有数次叛乱，但天牢永远是最稳固的。
夜幕渐渐落下，雨势停止，天牢旁的树木滴着雨珠，在地面上的坑洼中泛起涟漪。
张天忍正在跟兄弟们聊晚上吃啥，忽然听闻一阵悠扬的笛声传来。
他举目望去，天牢大门前的街道两侧阁楼紧闭，望不见人影。
“什么声音？”
“没看到人啊？”
“我怎么没有听到？”
“你前两年去芳香楼被你家的恶婆娘发现，一耳光把你耳朵拍得不灵了，你当然听不到。”
守卫们议论着，中年将领脸色大变，惊叫道：“不好！捂住耳朵！”
此言一出，守卫们虽被吓到，但还是下意识捂住耳朵，包括张天忍。
张天忍忽然瞧见街道尽头涌来一阵大雾，雾中有一道身影若隐若现，从身形能看得出他在吹笛。
“有人要劫狱？”
张天忍脑海里冒出这样一个念头，他刚要开口，地面巨颤。
轰隆隆——
众人努力稳住脚步，张天忍察觉到什么，下意识扭头看去。
一声巨响响起，天牢大门炸开，厚重的牢门被轰成数不清的木刺，张天忍的脸颊被划破，他跟着瞪大眼睛。
一道身影从天牢之中踏出，此人身穿破旧囚衣，手脚缠着铁链，披头散发，他佝偻着背脊，大口喘气。
他抬起头，杂乱的黑发之下显露出一双没有瞳孔的白色眼睛，在黑夜下闪烁着寒芒。
“鬼目……邪王……”
一名守卫颤声道，跟着一屁股跌坐在地上。

鬼目邪王踏步向前走去，他双脚的铁链竟然还勒着一名狱卒的脖子，将其身体从黑暗中拖拽出来，这名狱卒还活着，双目暴突，脸色涨红，他的双手抓着铁链，努力想要挣脱。
张天忍见到这一幕，眼睛都红了，他立即拔剑，冲向鬼目邪王。
鬼目邪王猛地冲到他面前，右手锁住他的脖子，将他怒砸在地上，砸得地面碎石乱飞。
张天忍差点晕厥过去，五脏六腑遭受重创，口中忍不住喷血。
鬼目邪王咧嘴一笑，笑得无比狰狞，如同恶鬼在人间。
就在他要结果张天忍时，笛声戛然而止，一道声音飘来：“别忘了正事。”
闻言，鬼目邪王停手，纵身一跃，跃起数丈高，拖着被铁链缠绕的狱卒跃向树林里，迅速消失。
大量狱卒从牢门内跑出，大多都受了伤，中年将领跑到张天忍前，检查他的伤势。
张天忍死死盯着鬼目邪王消失的方向，心中满是挫败感，他原以为自己已经够强，可没想到一个照面就对方击溃。
屋内，油灯摇曳。
姜长生正在打坐练功，他突然有些心绪不宁，总觉得要发生什么事。
他睁开眼睛，心想道：“今夜无蛙鸣，必有杀气。”
他感受着体内澎湃的真气，心稍安。
敌人应该不至于强过清虚道长太多，否则他早就被强杀。
一炷香时间后。
姜长生忽然听到山下传来喊叫声，但距离太远，他这位修仙者也听不清楚。
敌人不会强闯吧？
姜长生皱眉想到，再怎么说，这里也是京城，又是皇帝钦点的道观，若是闹大了，必然被皇帝追查。
与此同时。
半山腰的山路上，鬼目邪王走在石阶上，双手各捏着一名道士的脖子，身后被铁链拖着的狱卒浑身是血，已经不成人形。

月夜下，雷云骤然聚集而来，一道闪电划破夜空，让京城如处白昼，鬼目邪王的面容在一瞬间被照亮，是那么的狰狞可怕。
“大胆！竟敢强闯龙起观！”
上方传来一名道士的怒喝声，只见一名道士提剑杀来，他纵身跃起，一剑刺来，剑刃划破夜空，寒芒迸现。
鬼目邪王的右手掐断手中道士的脖子，跟着一掌拍出，真气爆发，化为一阵血风迎面撞上执剑道士。
执剑道士被血风撞上，吐血跌飞上去，如同断了线的风筝，砸在台阶上，他捂住胸口，想要站起来，但气血攻心，头一歪就晕过去。
“龙起观？不过如此，只是得了真龙的偏爱罢了。”
鬼目邪王哼道，沙哑的声音之中透着浓浓的不屑。
他加快脚步，如同鬼魅冲上山去。
房门援。”
姜长生一听，立即起身，与青苦一同走出房门。
来到庭院，姜长生一跃，直接消失于夜色之中，青苦愣在原地，他咬了咬牙，连忙追上去。
龙起观大门前，鬼目邪王停下脚步，他双手松开，两具尸体落下。
惊雷掠过夜空，照亮他身后的石阶，遍布尸体，鲜血顺着石阶流下去，蔓延至黑暗之中。
大门内，孟秋河执剑站在小桥上，怒视鬼目邪王，沉声喝道：“你是谁，为何屠戮我龙起观？”
鬼目邪王咧嘴一笑，道：“将死之人，想拉一些垫背的，既然清虚老儿不在，那你们先死吧！”
他猛地冲向孟秋河，动若雷霆，孟秋河脸色一变，快速挥剑，一道道剑气斩出，迎面杀向对方。
鬼目邪王一掌打出，掌风霸道，震散剑气，将孟秋河击飞出去，撞穿后方阁楼的墙壁，掀起滚滚尘土。
“一群废物，没想到老夫最后一战就是杀一群鸡犬。”
鬼目邪王收掌，不屑哼道，他走向孟秋河，但没走几步突然停下来。
content_en:
The fourth prince, Jiang Yu.
Jiang Changsheng knew about him, and learned from Chen Li that Jiang Yu was his biological brother, with the same father and mother, and the son of the empress. It was said that it was because of Jiang Yu that the empress stopped going crazy.
Hearing that it was the emperor who directed Jiang Yu to come here, Jiang Changsheng began to think a lot.
Could it be that the emperor already recognized him, why didn't he directly acknowledge him?
Jiang Changsheng couldn't ask about this directly, so he asked: "Do you want to practice martial arts with me?"
Jiang Yu said excitedly: "Yes, my father said that you are only two years older than me, but you have already surpassed the first-class level. You should be my master. I will satisfy you whatever you want. Gold, silver, treasures, rare treasures, just ask."
Jiang Changsheng thought for a while. With the prince's relationship, at least he would not be so passive in the future. He would not have to hide at all. After all, his enemies knew he was here.
"Since it is His Majesty's order, I naturally cannot refuse. It is also an honor for me to teach His Highness martial arts. But let me say first that the martial arts I teach are all my own creations and are not Long Qiguan's martial arts."
Jiang Changsheng said seriously. Jiang Yu was overjoyed and immediately knelt down to kowtow. The two guards were shocked, but fortunately Jiang Changsheng helped Jiang Yu in time.
This guy is really reckless...
Making the prince kowtow is a serious crime of beheading!
Jiang Changsheng said helplessly: "I am not your master, I just teach you martial arts. You can call me by my name from now on."
Jiang Yu straightened his back, grinned and said, "Okay, Brother Changsheng!"
He couldn't wait to urge: "Brother Changsheng, teach me quickly. My goal is to learn unparalleled martial arts, expand my territory for my great future, and wipe out the wilderness. I just turned twelve years old a few days ago. My father did not allow me to practice martial arts before I was twelve years old. You were the first person to teach me martial arts."
Jiang Changsheng thought for a while and decided to teach Jiang Yu the Divine Shadow Leg.
The Shadow Kick was the first martial art he learned. It was so powerful that one leg could break bones and tendons. He had already reached a powerful state where he could release his true energy and kick out strange phenomena.
Jiang Changsheng began to teach the cultivation method of Shenying Leg. The two guards avoided suspicion and retreated outside the door, closing the door.
Jiang Yu listened very carefully.
An hour later, Jiang Yu left happily. He had to go back to the palace to practice martial arts. The prince could not stay outside.
Qing Ku returned to the room and asked excitedly: "Senior brother, are you the prince's master now?"
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and laughed: "I'm just teaching His Highness martial arts. How can I be a master? Don't talk nonsense."
Qing Ku disagreed: "That's very strong. The prince will be your supporter from now on. I traveled around the world before and found that this world is a world of human relationships. If you do the same thing with different identities and relationships, the results will be completely different."
He seemed to have thought of something sad, and his smile disappeared.
Jiang Changsheng has always been curious about what he went through, but he never refused to tell.
The room fell into silence.
After a while, Qing Ku said goodbye, and Jiang Changsheng was the only one left in the room, and he could finally practice with peace of mind.
After the first assassination failed, the enemy would inevitably attack a second time, and Jiang Changsheng had to become as strong as possible.
Jiang Changsheng's cultivation at the third level of Taoist Natural Skills is enough to surpass Long Qiguan. For now, he has not met anyone with more Qi than him, but he is not afraid of ten thousand, just in case, so he cannot relax.
How could a cultivator be killed by a group of mortal warriors?
Dusk fell, dark clouds enveloped the bustling capital, and a steady drizzle fell.
Vendors on both sides of the street began to close their stalls one after another. The rolling red buildings were covered with a layer of mist, and the whole city became hazy.
In the western part of the capital, in front of the Tianlao Gate.
Zhang Tianren, who was dressed in armor, frowned and looked at the sky, his brows filled with worry.
A middle-aged general next to him patted him on the shoulder and said with a smile: "Young man, don't always be worried. The boss has already reported your name list, and you can take part in the martial arts examination next year."
Zhang Tianren just turned eighteen this year. His mother was pregnant with him when she was imprisoned. She was beheaded after giving birth to him.He was brought up by the jailers of Tianlao. The older generation of jailers regarded him as their own son and taught him various martial arts skills. He did indeed strive for success and made many meritorious deeds.
Zhang Tianren looked away, shook his head and said, "I always feel that something is going to happen in Tianlao."
"That's nonsense. Is there anyone who dares to rob a prison under the Emperor's feet?"
The middle-aged general laughed and cursed, while other nearby guards laughed.
In the capital, Tianlao is the safest place, and their responsibilities are also very simple. They enjoy their current life, not tired, but with high salary.
Zhang Tianren smiled helplessly, and he also felt that he might have thought too much.
Since the founding of Dajing, although there have been several rebellions in the capital, Tianlao has always been the most stable.
The night gradually fell and the rain stopped. The trees next to the sky prison were dripping with raindrops, causing ripples in the potholes on the ground.
Zhang Tianren was chatting with his brothers about what to eat for dinner when he suddenly heard the sound of a melodious flute.
He raised his eyes and saw that the attics on both sides of the street in front of the Tianlao gate were closed, and no one could be seen.
"What sound?"
"Didn't you see anyone?"
"Why didn't I hear it?"
"Two years ago, you went to Fangxiang Building and your evil wife discovered you. She slapped your ears so hard that of course you couldn't hear them."
The guards were talking, and the middle-aged general's face changed drastically, and he exclaimed: "No! Cover your ears!"
As soon as these words came out, although the guards were frightened, they subconsciously covered their ears, including Zhang Tianren.
Zhang Tianren suddenly saw a heavy fog coming from the end of the street. There was a figure looming in the fog. From his figure, he could be seen playing the flute.
"Someone wants to rob the prison?"
Such a thought came to Zhang Tianren's mind. Just as he was about to speak, the ground shook violently.
Rumble——
Everyone tried to steady their steps. Zhang Tianren noticed something and subconsciously turned his head to look.
There was a loud noise, and the prison door exploded. The heavy prison door was blasted into countless wooden thorns. Zhang Tianren's cheek was scratched, and his eyes widened.
A figure stepped out from the sky prison. This person was wearing a shabby prison uniform, his hands and feet were tied with iron chains, his hair was disheveled, his back was hunched, and he was breathing heavily.
He raised his head, revealing a pair of white eyes without pupils under his messy black hair, shining coldly in the dark night.
"Ghost Eyes...Evil King..."
A guard said tremblingly, then fell to the ground.
The Evil King of Ghost Eyes stepped forward, and the iron chains on his feet actually strangled the neck of a jailer, dragging his body out of the darkness. The jailer was still alive, his eyes bulging, his face flushed, and he was holding on to the iron chains with both hands, trying hard to break free.
Zhang Tianren's eyes turned red when he saw this scene. He immediately drew his sword and rushed towards the Ghost Eye Evil King.
Ghost Eye Evil King suddenly rushed in front of him, locked his neck with his right hand, and smashed him to the ground, causing gravel to fly everywhere.
Zhang Tianren almost fainted, his internal organs were severely damaged, and he could not help but spurt blood from his mouth.
The Ghost-Eyed Evil King grinned, and his smile was extremely ferocious, like an evil ghost in the human world.
Just when he was about to kill Zhang Tianren, the sound of the flute suddenly stopped, and a voice floated over: "Don't forget the business."
Hearing this, the Ghost Eyed Evil King stopped, jumped several feet high, dragged the jailer entangled in iron chains, jumped into the woods, and quickly disappeared.
A large number of jailers ran out of the cell door, most of them injured. The middle-aged general ran to Zhang Tianren to check his injuries.
Zhang Tianren stared at the direction where the Ghost Eye Evil King disappeared, his heart full of frustration. He thought he was strong enough, but he didn't expect that he would be defeated in a single confrontation.
Inside the house, oil lamps flickered.
Jiang Changsheng was meditating and practicing. He suddenly felt uneasy and felt that something was going to happen.
He opened his eyes and thought to himself: "If there are no frogs crowing tonight, there must be murderous intent."
He felt the surging energy in his body and felt a little at ease.
The enemy should not be much stronger than Taoist Master Qingxu, otherwise he would have been killed long ago.
After one stick of incense.
Jiang Changsheng suddenly heard shouting from down the mountainHe screamed, but the distance was too far for him, an immortal cultivator, to hear clearly.
The enemy won't force their way in, right?
Jiang Changsheng frowned and thought, after all, this is the capital, and it is a Taoist temple appointed by the emperor. If it gets too big, the emperor will definitely investigate.
at the same time.
On the mountain road halfway up the mountain, Ghost Eye Evil King was walking on the stone steps, holding the neck of a Taoist priest with each hand. The jailer behind him was dragged by chains and was covered in blood and no longer human.
Under the moonlit night, thunderclouds suddenly gathered, and a bolt of lightning pierced the night sky, making the capital seem like daylight. The face of the Ghost Eyed Evil King was illuminated in an instant, making it so ferocious and terrifying.
"Bold! How dare you force your way into Longqi Temple!"
An angry shout from a Taoist priest came from above, and a Taoist priest was seen approaching with a sword. He jumped up and stabbed with his sword. The sword blade cut through the night sky, and a cold light burst out.
Ghost Eye Evil King's right hand cut off the Taoist priest's neck, and then slapped it with a palm. The true energy exploded, turning into a bloody wind and hitting the Taoist priest holding the sword head-on.
The sword-holding Taoist priest was hit by the bloody wind, vomited blood and flew up, like a kite with a broken string, and hit the steps. He covered his chest and tried to stand up, but the blood and blood attacked his heart and he fainted as soon as he tilted his head.
"Long Qi Guan? That's all. He just got the real dragon's preference."
Ghost Eye Evil King hummed, his hoarse voice filled with deep disdain.
He quickened his pace and rushed up the mountain like a ghost.
Room door aid. "
When Jiang Changsheng heard this, he immediately stood up and walked out of the room with Qing Ku.
Arriving at the courtyard, Jiang Changsheng jumped and disappeared directly into the night. Qing Qing froze in place. He gritted his teeth and quickly chased after him.
In front of the gate of Longqiguan, the Ghost Eyed Evil King stopped. He let go of his hands, and the two corpses fell down.
Thunder swept through the night sky, illuminating the stone steps behind him, which were covered with corpses. Blood flowed down the stone steps and spread into the darkness.
Inside the gate, Meng Qiuhe stood on the small bridge holding a sword, glaring at the Ghost Eyed Evil King angrily, and shouted in a deep voice: "Who are you, and why did you kill me, Long Qiguan? "
The Ghost Eye Evil King grinned and said: "Those who are about to die want to help some people support them. Since old man Qingxu is not here, you should die first! "
He rushed towards Meng Qiuhe fiercely, moving like thunder. Meng Qiuhe's expression changed, he quickly swung his sword, and slashed out sword energy one after another, heading towards the opponent.
The Ghost Eye Evil King struck out with a palm, and the palm wind was domineering, dissipating the sword energy, knocking Meng Qiuhe away, crashing through the wall of the attic behind, and kicking up billowing dust.
"A bunch of trash, I didn't expect that my last battle would be to kill a bunch of chickens and dogs. "
The Ghost Eye Evil King closed his palm and snorted disdainfully. He walked towards Meng Qiuhe, but stopped suddenly after taking a few steps.
